reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets doubled from ~600/mo (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/mo (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-05), and this is not explained by slow ticket response (within SLA, E-02) or a tariff change (none logged, E-04). The majority of disputed bills (1785/3025, ~59%) are tied to accepted ACTUAL reads rather than ESTIMATED reads (E-03), indicating the surge is driven predominantly by billing errors arising upstream of the estimate-substitution step - in actual-read collection/MDMS validation or billing import/validation - rather than by the field-read route-completion shortfall (E-01) that produces estimated bills.
